newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee dips in volatile trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee dips in volatile trade.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee slipped against the dollar in volatile trading on Thursday, dealers said.
At 0500 GMT the rupee was quoted at 58.61 to the dollar, after touching an earlier low of 58.65 and against the opening at 58.60, they said.
"The exchange rate has been volatile because import covering is helping the dollar up," said an American Express Bank dealer.
Some dealers said speculative activity also helped pushed up the dollar.
The Central Bank pushed up the exchange rate by quarter of a local cent, fixing buying and selling prices at 58.4768 and 59.6582.
Overnight call money rate stood at 8.75 percent and the overnight repo rate was 8.75 percent.
